title: 第13章 天行百变第14章 炼气五层
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
这名修士的储物袋中一共有四本书籍和一卷地图。
看到是地图，秦怀安大喜。地图画的并不太详细，像是手绘的，但云田坊市还是清清楚楚的标记在了上面。
地图记录的范围大致为启国、陈国和晋国及它们相邻的百万大山外围区域。
启国在中间，晋国东面，陈国在西面。地图上标记了三个国家的国都，及启国的修仙坊市云田坊市、晋国的修仙坊市东莱坊市。
三个国家南面均与百万大山相连。地图上用小字标注了他们所在的这片区域了。这里应该是这位修士的一个据点，所以重点标注了此位置。此地与两个修仙坊市之间还弯弯曲曲的画着两条路线。
两条路线都是选择了按较短的距离走出百万大山，然后再走人类疆域去往两个坊市。
此地在云田坊市东南方向，距云田坊市约2000里，距东莱坊市约5000里。
“太好了，还有路线图。秦兄，按这个路线我们应该很快就能出去了。”王宝乐很兴奋，终于看到走出去的希望，不用盲目乱走了。
秦怀安盯着胖子说道：“2000里的路程，还大部分是在百万大山区域，你猜我们会遇到多少妖兽？”
小胖子顿时蔫了下来，今天还没走出去多远就遇到了一阶后期的妖兽，差点交代到这里。
如果不用神行符，以他们的速度，在百万大山里走2000里，至少要五六天的时间。
“我们再看看其他书。”
一本《长春功》，是一种基础修炼功法，包含炼气期和筑基期的功法。
“好东西！”秦怀安说道。他的青华诀只有炼气期的内容，以前修炼太慢，原主并未考虑寻找筑基期功法。以秦怀安现在的修炼速度，筑基期不会太久了。
一本《天行百变》，是一种修炼身法、步法的功法，对于还不会飞行的炼气期修士极为有用。此功法修炼到极致，速度可提高5倍以上。
一本《丹药基础》，里面分两部分，第一部分图文并茂的介绍了各种常用灵草的形状、功效、药材处理方法等，比秦怀安的《药草初解》要全面详细的多。
第二部分是几种丹药的丹方和详细的炼制术法。其中包含了辟谷丹、回气丹、凝血丹、淬体丹、筑基丹等。
其实在坊市中丹药的配方并不难得到，但成为炼丹师很难，不但要有炼丹天赋，还要用大量的灵草锻炼，可以说炼丹师都是灵石堆砌起来的。
最后还有一本封面写着《大晋风情录》，里面记载了晋国各地的风月场所，以及这些地方发生的一些趣事。
翻来这本书，里面也是图文并茂，小胖子顿时面红耳赤，想转身不看，但视线又移不开，骂骂咧咧道：“这修士也不是什么好鸟。”

“哈哈哈......”秦怀安大笑，“胖子，这个少儿不宜，我先保管起来。”
说着收起来放到了一边。
然后和王宝乐认真说道：“胖子，你应该还没有储物袋吧。这样，储物袋归你，灵石归我，我借你灵符丹药你也不用还我了。书籍你可以抄录一份。”
“不用不用，秦兄，我的命都是你救的，这些东西都归你，我不能要。”
“别婆婆妈妈，储物袋我已经有了，这个就给你了，书籍的话，等到了坊市你可以抄录一份。”
王宝乐和秦怀安一路走来，也算是他在这个世界的第一个朋友，而且王宝乐还是很淳朴的，人还不错。虽然一路走来秦怀安是主要战力，但王宝乐也不可或缺。这既然是共患难得到的，就理应分他一份。
何况秦怀安有种子空间，而且已经有了一个储物袋做掩饰，再多一个也没什么大用。灵石对他有大用，他就没和小胖子客气。
“那就多谢秦兄了，以后秦兄你就是我的亲大哥了。”
“我已不做大哥好多年！”秦怀安调侃道。
王宝乐微微愣了一下，并不明白秦怀安为什么说我已不做大哥好多年，认真说了：“秦大哥，以后我的命就是大哥的，大哥让我往东我绝不往西，让我......”
“行了，别废话了，我们想想接下来怎么办吧。”秦怀安拍拍王宝乐的肩膀说道。
“我们按照地图往云田坊市走？”王宝乐问道。
“胖子，你还有神行符吗？”
content_en:
There are a total of four books and a map in this monk's storage bag.
Qin Huaian was overjoyed when he saw it was a map. The map is not very detailed and looks like it was hand-drawn, but Yuntianfang City is still clearly marked on it.
The scope recorded on the map is roughly Qi State, Chen State and Jin State and their adjacent surrounding areas of Million Mountains.
The state of Qi is in the middle, the state of Jin is to the east, and the state of Chen is to the west. The capitals of three countries are marked on the map, as well as Yuntianfang City, Xiuxianfang City in Qi State, and Donglaifang City, Xiuxianfang City in Jin State.
The three countries are all connected to the Million Mountains in the south. The area where they are located is marked in small letters on the map. This should be a stronghold of this monk, so this location is highlighted. There are two winding routes between this place and the two Xiuxianfang cities.
Both routes took a shorter distance out of the Million Mountains, and then took the human territory to two cities.
This place is in the southeast of Yuntianfang City, about 2,000 miles away from Yuntianfang City and about 5,000 miles away from Donglaifang City.
"Great, there is also a road map. Brother Qin, according to this route we should be able to go out soon." Wang Baole was very excited, finally seeing the hope of going out, and no need to blindly walk around.
Qin Huaian stared at the fat man and said: "The 2,000-mile journey is mostly in the Million Mountains area. How many monsters do you think we will encounter?"
The little fat man suddenly became weak. He didn't go very far today when he encountered a late-level first-order monster and almost ended up here.
If they didn't use the magic walking talisman, at their speed, it would take at least five or six days to walk 2,000 miles in the millions of mountains.
"Let's look at other books."
"Changchun Gong" is a basic cultivation method, including exercises in the Qi refining stage and the foundation building stage.
"Good stuff!" Qin Huaian said. His Qing Hua Jue only covers the Qi Refining Stage. His previous practice was too slow, and the original owner did not consider looking for the Foundation Building Stage techniques. With Qin Huaian's current cultivation speed, the foundation building period won't be long.
The book "The Hundred Changes of Heaven's Movement" is a method for practicing body and footwork. It is extremely useful for monks in the Qi refining period who cannot fly yet. When this technique is practiced to the extreme, the speed can be increased by more than 5 times.
"Basics of Medicinal Herbs" is divided into two parts. The first part introduces the shapes, functions, medicinal materials processing methods of various commonly used spiritual herbs with pictures and texts, which is much more comprehensive and detailed than Qin Huaian's "Preliminary Explanation of Medicinal Herbs".
The second part is the prescriptions of several elixirs and detailed refining techniques. These include Bigu Pill, Qi Restoring Pill, Blood Coagulation Pill, Body Tempering Pill, Foundation Building Pill, etc.
In fact, it is not difficult to obtain the formula of elixirs in the market, but it is difficult to become an alchemist. Not only must you have the talent for alchemy, but you must also train with a large amount of spiritual herbs. It can be said that alchemists are built up of spiritual stones.
Finally, there is a book with the title "Record of Customs of the Jin Dynasty" written on the cover, which records the romantic places in various places in the Jin Dynasty and some interesting things that happened in these places.
Turning over the book, it was full of pictures and texts. The little fat man suddenly turned red and wanted to turn away, but he couldn't move his eyes away. He cursed and said: "This monk is not a good bird."
"Hahaha..." Qin Huaian laughed, "Fat man, this is not suitable for children, I will keep it for safekeeping first."
He said and put it aside.
Then he and Wang Baole said seriously: "Fat man, you probably don't have a storage bag yet. In this way, the storage bag belongs to you, the spiritual stone belongs to me, and you don't have to return the spiritual talisman and elixir to me if I lend you. You can make a copy of the book."
"No, no, no, brother Qin, you saved my life. These things belong to you. I can't have them."
"Farewell, mother-in-law, I already have the storage bag. I'll give this to you. As for the books, you can make a copy of them when you get to Fangshi."
Along the way, Wang Baole and Qin Huaian can be regarded as his first friends in this world, and Wang Baole is still very simple., the people are not bad. Although Qin Huaian was the main fighting force along the way, Wang Baole was also indispensable. Since this was obtained through shared hardships, he should share it.
What's more, Qin Huaian has seed space and already has a storage bag as a cover, so having another one is of little use. The spirit stone was of great use to him, so he was not polite to the little fat man.
"Thank you so much, Brother Qin. From now on, Brother Qin, you will be my eldest brother."
"I haven't been the eldest brother for many years!" Qin Huaian joked.
Wang Baole was stunned for a moment. He didn't understand why Qin Huaian said that I had stopped being the eldest brother for many years. He said seriously: "Brother Qin, from now on my life belongs to the eldest brother. If the eldest brother asks me to go east, I will never go west. Let me..."
"Okay, stop talking nonsense, let's think about what to do next." Qin Huaian patted Wang Baole on the shoulder and said.
"Shall we follow the map to Yuntianfang City?" Wang Baole asked.
"Fat man, do you still have the magic talisman?"
